description: Chamber seal. POST /v1/seal. Library door. Adds no per-seal price. Anonymous HTTP gets 402 until a key or claim. Seats already on the catalog: chamber-month, chamber-year. The metered crossing is chamber-seal at $0.02.

api_key.description: Bearer key or raw key when the door requires a tool credential.

authorization.description: Authorization header when the door is a Tollkeeper tool (Bearer ar_…).

obj.description: JSON value to seal. At least 8 bytes once serialized.

payment.description: x402 X-PAYMENT. Omit it and a paid door answers 402.

name: seal
